LanguageData.ABY_GatebreakerCarapace.label: gatebreaker carapace
LanguageData.ABY_GatebreakerCarapace.description: A late abyssal assault shell built for colonists who are no longer merely surviving controlled breaches, but preparing to break through them. Blackened plasteel plates, saint-reactor containment ribs and residue-lit pressure channels form a compact human-scale siege frame. It is stronger and more hostile than saint-line armor, but still beneath true crowned-core authority.
LanguageData.ABY_GatebreakerHelm.label: gatebreaker helm
LanguageData.ABY_GatebreakerHelm.description: A sealed assault helm with a predatory white gate-visor and layered black reactor plating. Its optics do not promise clarity so much as permission: authorized breaches, condemned targets and hostile silhouettes burn through the mask in a single grin of pale abyssal light.
